title: 第五章  手撕休书！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

三人分宾主落座，下人上了茶。

林龙虎小心翼翼地试探：

“不知道侯将军今日前来，所为何事啊？”

候承天这人是个爽快人，直接从袖子里掏出一份文书，往桌上一拍，开门见山道：

“本将军今日前来，是要跟林兄商议一件非常重要的事。”

“这是林澈和公主的合离书。”

“皇后娘娘让我送过来，把这事儿给办了。”

“既然林澈在这儿，那就签了吧，免得再生事端！”

林龙虎和林澈俩人同时往桌上看去，脸色刷一下就涨的通红。

这他娘的是羞辱！

是欺负人欺负到家门口来了！

虽说林澈之前已经答应公主解除婚约，可那是私下里说的，怎么着也得体体面面地把事儿办了。

没想到皇后娘娘这么着急，直接派候将军上门，逼着林家签休书！

林龙虎颤抖着手拿起休书，

上面写着：林澈与公主府内丫鬟私通，背弃公主，令皇室蒙羞受辱，故公主单方面解除婚约。

这罪名要是坐实了，林澈这辈子就完了！

整个林家都要跟着蒙羞！

这哪里是休书，分明是要把林家的脸皮撕下来，当抹布踩！

更狠的是，公主单方面解除婚约，还以林澈背叛为理由....

这就等于告诉全天下：不是我公主不要你，是你林澈不是东西，我公主才休了你！

此事要是传出去，林家在这皇城里头还怎么混？

林龙虎心里头那个恨啊，恨得牙根痒痒，可念及对方皇室身份总不能当场翻脸，只得道；

“候将军，您消消气，消消气。”

“犬子年轻不懂事，闯下这等大祸，是我的错，是我管教无方。”

“您看，有什么事情咱们可以慢慢商议嘛。”

“犬子和公主的婚事，毕竟是太后她老人家定下的，要是就这么解除了，皇室的脸上，恐怕也不太好看……”

候承天似笑非笑看了一眼林龙虎：

“国公爷可不要揣着明白装糊涂，如今大皇子正值壮年！”

“又是皇后亲子，咱们同为亲家却不能同仇敌忾！”

“你说要这亲家何用？”

林龙虎一听心里咯噔一下，该来的还是来了。

太子病逝，其生母整日以泪洗面不久便撒手人寰。

大皇子生母，也就是当今皇后荣登后位！

本意是大肆笼络林家，可林龙虎不想淌夺嫡这浑水，迟迟未能统一战线！

如今对方拿林家脸面来要挟，倒叫林龙虎一时间没了主意！

“候将军，你说的本国公，也明白，可是....”

候承天冷笑一声，那笑容冷得能结冰碴子：

“哼...”

“就是因你林家两面三刀，六皇子才逐渐做大，与大皇子有分庭抗礼之势！”

“既然你林家帮不了大皇子，这份姻亲还是趁早断了！”

“还有，我来是奉了皇后娘娘懿旨！”

“不是来跟你商议的！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The three of them were seated separately, and the servants served tea.

Lin Longhu carefully tested:

"I wonder why General Hou came here today?"

Hou Chengtian is a cheerful person. He took out a document directly from his sleeve, slapped it on the table, and said straight to the point:

"General, I came here today to discuss a very important matter with Brother Lin."

"This is the letter of separation between Lin Che and the princess."

"The Queen asked me to send it over and take care of this matter."

"Since Lin Che is here, let's sign it to avoid further trouble!"

Lin Longhu and Lin Che both looked at the table at the same time, their faces turning red immediately.

This is fucking humiliating!

It's the bullies who have come to the doorstep!

Although Lin Che had promised the princess to terminate the engagement before, she had said it in private, and she had to handle the matter with dignity no matter what.

Unexpectedly, the Empress was so anxious that she directly sent General Waiting to the door and forced the Lin family to sign a divorce letter!

Lin Longhu picked up the divorce letter with trembling hands,

It read: Lin Che had an affair with a maid in the princess's palace, betrayed the princess, and brought shame and humiliation to the royal family. Therefore, the princess unilaterally terminated the engagement.

If this crime is proven, Lin Che's life will be over!

The entire Lin family will be humiliated!

This is not a letter of divorce, it is clearly intended to tear off the Lin family's face and use it as a rag to trample on!

What's even more cruel is that the princess unilaterally terminated the engagement and cited Lin Che's betrayal as the reason...

This is equivalent to telling the whole world: It’s not my princess who doesn’t want you, it’s because you, Lin Che, are nothing, so my princess divorced you!

If this matter spreads out, how can the Lin family still hang out in this imperial city?

The hatred in Lin Longhu's heart was so intense that his teeth itched with hatred, but considering the royal status of the other party, he could not fall out on the spot, so he had to say;

"General Hou, calm down, calm down."

"The dog is young and ignorant. It's my fault that he got into such a big disaster. It's my fault for not being able to discipline him well."

"Look, if there is anything we can discuss slowly."

"After all, the marriage between Quanzi and the princess was decided by the Queen Mother. If it were to be canceled like this, I'm afraid the royal family's face would not look good..."

Hou Chengtian glanced at Lin Longhu with a half-smile but not a smile:

"My lord, don't pretend to be confused because you understand. The eldest prince is now in his prime!"

"We are the queen's son again. We are both in-laws, but we cannot share the same hatred and hatred!"

"What do you mean you need this in-laws for?"

Lin Longhu's heart skipped a beat when he heard this. What was supposed to come had finally come.

The prince died of illness, and his biological mother passed away in tears all day long.

The biological mother of the eldest prince, the current queen, has ascended to the throne!

The original intention was to win over the Lin family in a big way, but Lin Longhu didn't want to swim in the muddy water of seizing the direct descendants, so he was unable to unite the front!

Now that the other party was threatening the Lin family's face, Lin Longhu suddenly lost his mind!

"General Hou, I understand what you are talking about, my father-in-law, but..."

Hou Chengtian sneered, and his smile was so cold that it could freeze into ice:

"Humph..."

"It's because of your double-dealing in the Lin family that the Sixth Prince gradually grew bigger and rivaled the First Prince!"

"Since your Lin family can't help the eldest prince, it's better to end this marriage as soon as possible!"

"Also, I am here on the orders of the Queen!"

"I'm not here to discuss with you!"
